title: PQLS: A High-Performance Python Library for Steady-State Simulation of Open Quantum Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.12309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: PQLS (Parallel Quantum Liouvillian Solver) is a high-performance Python library for computing steady-state solutions of the Lindblad master equation. It provides a layered user-facing API with three levels of abstraction. The high-level API accepts physical descriptions of atomic ladder systems and automatically determines the required model parameters; the mid- level API accepts quantities such as Rabi frequencies, detunings, decay rates, and network topology; finally the low-level API allows users to directly specify the Hamiltonian and collapse operators. This layered design enables users to choose between physical convenience and direct numerical control depending on the application. PQLS is built on JAX and XLA to enable vectorized and hardware-accelerated computation of large parameter sweeps. Rather than solving the steady-state problem sequentially for each parameter configuration, PQLS represents multiple Hamiltonians as batched

translated_title: PQLS：一个用于开放量子系统稳态仿真的高性能Python库
translated_abstract: PQLS（并行量子刘维尔求解器）是一个用于计算Lindblad主方程稳态解的高性能Python库。它提供了具有三个抽象层级的分层用户API：高层API接受原子阶梯系统的物理描述，并自动确定所需的模型参数；中层API接受诸如拉比频率、失谐、衰减率和网络拓扑结构等物理量；底层API则允许用户直接指定哈密顿量和坍缩算符。这种分层设计使用户能够根据应用需求在物理便利性与直接数值控制之间进行选择。PQLS基于JAX和XLA构建，以实现对大规模参数扫描的向量化与硬件加速计算。PQLS并非针对每个参数配置依次求解稳态问题，而是将多个哈密顿量表示为批量化的形式（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: PQLS是一个基于JAX和XLA构建的高性能Python库，通过三层抽象API设计和批量化并行计算，实现对开放量子系统Lindblad主方程稳态解的高效求解和大规模参数扫描加速。
en_tdlr: PQLS is a high-performance Python library built on JAX and XLA that efficiently solves steady-state solutions of the Lindblad master equation through a three-level layered API and batched, hardware-accelerated parallel computation for large parameter sweeps.
